findings.highlight: I will kill you if come any closer.
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上近づかれると殺してしまう
findings.governingReading: それ以上近づかれると refers to Shirou approaching closer under her control.
findings.explanation: The conditional threat drops its subject.

findings.highlight: But Caster can manipulate anybody in town without moving from here
findings.evidenceJa: という事ではないのか
findings.governingReading: The narrator reasons if she can accomplish this remote control, would it not mean she can manipulate the town from here?
findings.explanation: A conditional town-wide-control deduction becomes an asserted capability.

findings.highlight: I wish for them to live
findings.evidenceJa: 殺さない程度に生かし続けて
findings.governingReading: Caster describes continually keeping people alive without killing them so that she can extract their energy to the last drop.
findings.explanation: Caster's continuing maintenance of living victims becomes a wish that they live. Her purpose of extracting all their magical energy remains explicit.

findings.highlight: now I can gather it most efficiently.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はほどよく集められる
findings.governingReading: 加減がつかない followed by ほどよく marks initial inability to calibrate the amount and present appropriate collection.
findings.explanation: Learning proper extraction degree becomes maximal efficiency.
